description: Browse the public Opedd license registry. Returns recently issued licenses and licensable content. Filter by publisher_id to explore all content from a specific publisher. Filter by article_id to see all licenses issued for a specific article.

article_id.description: Filter results to a specific article (UUID)

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

publisher_id.description: Filter results to a specific publisher (UUID)

name: browse_registry
